assignment.title: What Is the Difference Between a Lip Flip and Lip Filler?

rules.rule: Answer assigned reader question clearly, accurately, thoroughly; explain supported answers before individual consultation advice.
At least 1,200 substantive words; no filler; each section adds distinct useful information.
rules.verification: body word count plus section/passages assessment

rules.rule: Localized treatment education, practical subtopics, supported practice integration, authoritative support, localized CTA.
Practice website research before third-party sources; supplied reference is starting point, not template.
Preserve correct location, geography, role, credential, service and treatment associations; no invented provider-procedure mapping.

rules.condition: Supported expertise helps explanation or consultation choice
rules.disposition: Include Martins and Mensah's relevant injectable expertise; do not claim specific booking mapping.

rules.rule: Conversational, active, clear, natural; no copied content, repetitive wording, generic AI phrasing, unnecessary technical language, long blocks or keyword stuffing.

rules.disposition: Concern, core answer, timing/recovery/safety preview; no early selling.

rules.rule: Descriptive reader-focused H2s, logical H1/H2/H3 hierarchy as needed; AP headline capitalization.

rules.condition: Improves organization or answers reader questions

rules.rule: Aim sixth- to ninth-grade level, short sentences, most paragraphs one or two sentences; bullets when useful.
rules.verification: Approximate grade and editorial explanation; no formula-only pass.

rules.rule: Preserve assigned title and SEO label; relevant topic terms naturally.

rules.disposition: Olney, MD; verified physical address; no invented satellite location or forced markets.

rules.rule: Four useful unique internal content links for this length; CTA excluded; first typically primary service.

rules.disposition: Cleveland Clinic and FDA; no competitors or directories.

rules.rule: End with clear customized scheduling invitation and link and/or verified phone.
Fact check; realistic expectations, explicit medical limits, no guaranteed results, risk-free promises, unsupported statistics or fabricated expertise.

rules.disposition: Optional clinician perspective on lip function; omitted; one anchored comment prepared.
Not useful to mechanism/decision answer; omit.

rules.condition: Genuine attributable testimonial useful to answer
rules.disposition: Comparative answer needs clinical explanations, not social proof; omit.

rules.rule: Assess dependency; required when needed for applicable rule or central claim. Use supported wording/omission when adequate. Optional material alone does not block readiness.
rules.disposition: No missing required facts; fee/dose/provider scheduling remain personal planning details, not central dependencies.

rules.rule: Spell one through nine; numerals 10 and above; percent symbol; AP dates when applicable.
BMP MD, VA, DC conventions when appropriate.
Professional titles uppercase only before names.
Oxford comma; AP compound modifiers.
301-555-1234 phone format; verify real phone; correct business name and terminology.
Fact check, substantial editing, grammar/spelling/final proofreading and affected checks on final version.
Alex provides human review after delivery; AI assessment does not establish human review or acceptance.
